column1: # Part of the Model Predictive Control in buildings repository
# Single source of truth for the file names of every configuration
# file that lives directly under 30_Simulation/02_Config/. Consumed
# by 20_GUI/01_Configure_Simulation/GUI_config.R so that the GUI and
# the rest of the project do not each keep their own hard-coded copy
#   key      : identifier used by the code to look up the path
#   unit     : always "-" (a file path has no physical unit); kept so
#              a missing value is never ambiguous between "no unit"
